stories.headline: Zerodha Launches US Stock Investing, Offers Access To 2,000 Stocks
stories.summary: Indian discount brokerage Zerodha has launched US stock investing in beta mode on its Kite trading platform. The new feature gives Indian retail investors access to trade approximately 2,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs directly through the app.

stories.headline: Kiwi edtech SupaHuman chalks up $2.6 million Series for Australian plans
stories.summary: New Zealand edtech startup SupaHuman raised NZ$2.6 million in funding led by venture capital firm Movac to expand its operations into Australia. The company develops AI software, including its VETos and Nova 5 platforms, to automate the creation, validation, and delivery of vocational education and workplace training materials.

stories.headline: Anthropic says it will commit 5% of its shares to 'public benefit fund'
stories.summary: AI startup Anthropic has announced plans to allocate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund dedicated to supporting nonprofits and mitigating AI's impact on jobs and society. The commitment comes as the Claude developer prepares for a potential initial public offering (IPO). An additional 2% of shares may be directed to the fund at the discretion of the company's board.
